subtitle: Talent Forge Precision Controls — Drag & Rank Inspector Repair
changes: Fixed Talent Atlas dragging by starting pointer capture only after intentional movement, reducing interference with node button clicks and touch interactions.
Preserved the current tree viewport when ranking talents so node positions do not abruptly jump or reset after edits.
Improved detailed talent inspector responsiveness: rank buttons use original planner controls without unexpected inspector auto-scrolling.
Added a non-destructive rank-effect preview selector with an explicit apply-one-step action to examine Blizzard-returned rank descriptions before spending points.
Increased node button tap targets, improved focus styles, and refreshed site scripts with cache-busting for PC and mobile.
Kept saved builds, existing talent IDs, undo/redo, Media Studio, account integration and all other functionality unchanged.
